title: This Centrist Democrat Wants to Abolish ICE and Condition Aid to Israel
author: Team Zeteo
content:
Democrats should be doing victory laps right now, after President Donald
Trump's rambling State of the Union address is already
[polling](https://www.newsweek.com/donald-trump-state-of-the-union-speech-
least-popular-this-century-poll-11578100) as the least popular SOTU speech of
the century.

Yet, the party still appears to be in worse shape than ever before, suffering
from their own record-low approval ratings.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Perhaps that's why people like Rep. Seth Moulton, a 47-year old Iraq War
veteran, are calling for a change in leadership, as he
[challenges](https://www.politico.com/news/2025/10/15/seth-moulton-ed-markey-
senate-00608034) 79-year old Senator Ed Markey for his Massachusetts Senate
seat.

**" He hasn't helped us win. And that's what we need to do right now in this
moment," **Moulton says to Mehdi, saying he would not vote to keep Chuck
Schumer as leader of the Democrats in the Senate.

In this wide-ranging and challenging interview with the centrist Democratic
congressman, **Mehdi** asks Moulton whether he can beat a progressive
incumbent senator with such high approval ratings, and also challenges him on
his own voting record in the House.

Mehdi specifically brings up a GOP-led resolution Moulton voted in favor of
last November - one that
[condemned](https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/house-condemns-socialism-
bill-zohran-mamdani/) the "horrors of socialism," after Democratic socialist
Zohran Mamdani's historic mayoral victory in New York City.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

**" Does that mean you're denouncing AOC and Bernie Sanders and Zohran
Mamdani?"** Mehdi asks Moulton.

**" No, absolutely not… I actually read resolutions," **Moulton says to Mehdi
before explaining and defending his vote.

Mehdi and the congressman also discuss the moment where Moulton's staff had to
escort out his SOTU guest - 19-year-old Marcelo Gomes da Silva, who was
detained by ICE last year - during Trump's speech, after DHS
[threatened](https://www.bostonglobe.com/2026/02/25/metro/marcelo-gomes-state-
union/) him on social media.

**" It should be abolished, but also it should be prosecuted," **Moulton says
of ICE, as he urges his party leadership to get behind these policies.
